summary_md: **Tian Zhang (Brice) ([@BriceTian](https://x.com/BriceTian/status/2115096262449995940))** summarizes *Cache Engineering for Agents*: letting an agent drop its own KV-cache entries beats threshold-triggered summarization (+1.7 points average, 27.7% lower cost). Follow-ups explain the agent issues cache ops directly (dropping tool responses from future attention, rotating position encodings of kept entries) with no re-prefill, served by an AKV engine at 1.2x output throughput, and note caveats: small gains on 100-task subsets and no variance reported.
relevance: Moves context management from prompt hacks into the serving layer.
